video_title: Donte DiVincenzo's Comeback Is Starting to Look Real | Day Zero Episode Five

quotes.speaker: Phil Booth
quotes.summary_phrase: Phil Booth on Donte DiVincenzo's dedication to his injury rehabilitation
quotes.excerpt: he found ways of thinking of when I get back, how I can be better here
quotes.quote: How much he attacked the rehab from day one feels like, and how even being hurt, he found ways of thinking of when I get back, how I can be better here, how I can be better there, and how me being hurt, I can get better at this. I mean he's got so much stronger now too.

quotes.speaker: Donte DiVincenzo
quotes.summary_phrase: Donte DiVincenzo on the mental benefits of his six-month check-in
quotes.excerpt: It allowed me to have the confidence going forward to my next workouts to not necessarily think
quotes.quote: This visit was a little bit more of just confirmation and confidence of like, I had already in my mind kind of knew what he was going to say because of the work I've been putting in. But just to hear him say it, it kind of cleared that, checked that box. It allowed me to have the confidence going forward to my next workouts to not necessarily think about anything, just go, you know, workout as normal and trust my Achilles and trust my body.

quotes.speaker: Martin O'Malley
quotes.summary_phrase: Dr. O'Malley confirms Donte DiVincenzo is ahead of schedule in recovery
quotes.excerpt: you're on schedule if not certainly ahead of schedule with your strength and all your numbers

text_blocks.speaker: Martin O'Malley
text_blocks.text: We can easily say you're on schedule if not certainly ahead of schedule with your strength and all your numbers, right? Don't dismiss the mental aspect of this. I mean you're doing nothing when you get it. It's good that you're with the team. They see you, you're with them, you're part of it. To be part of it mentally for you is important.

text_blocks.speaker: Martin O'Malley
text_blocks.text: I mean when this happened, the goal is to be back for this season. That's not a question. And when you go back, it's you guys, the team. It's mostly when you feel like you're ready, when you feel normal.

quotes.speaker: Donte DiVincenzo
quotes.summary_phrase: Donte DiVincenzo on the mental battle of recovering from an injury
quotes.excerpt: Half this rehab is just a mental battle. So when you get confirmation or affirmation from the doctor
quotes.quote: Half this rehab is just a mental battle. So when you get confirmation or affirmation from the doctor and you're feeling good, but when you hear the doctor say that you are good and you can progress and you can keep doing more, then all of a sudden mentally you just feel like, oh I got more in me. And you start to push a little bit more without being scared. Basically his words match how I'm feeling.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on Donte DiVincenzo's work ethic during his recovery
quotes.excerpt: he's working hard as anyone, like he's still in the gym
quotes.quote: I mean you see how hard he was working, the day he got the boot on till now. And like he's working hard as anyone, like he's still in the gym. It's just something that he wants to be back in the game and about every day. And I'm excited for whenever he come back, we're going to be ready for him.

quotes.speaker: Donte DiVincenzo
quotes.summary_phrase: Donte DiVincenzo on the importance of playing simple basketball
quotes.excerpt: It's simple basketball and I think when we're at our best is when we play simple basketball
quotes.quote: It's simple basketball and I think when we're at our best is when we play simple basketball and these guys are so damn talented that when I do come back, I can just plug and play and try to take them to another level.
